Educational Supervisor's Structured Report (ESSR) completed on the LLP
Built from your evidence and signed off by your Educational Supervisor and College Tutor. Send it to your ES at least 2 weeks before the panel.
It starts the day after your last ARCP ended.
Placements since your last ARCP listed
Good practice every year, and strongly recommended at the end of ST6.
Personal development plan with this year's learning objectives
Objectives in a supervisor meeting record count; say where they are. You can add new ones during the year.
Cases since your last ARCP and a cumulative log from the start of core training. The LLP logbook is preferred.
LLP meetings, an end-of-placement ESSR or an uploaded school form all count.
Supervised learning events across the domains
A-CEX, CBD, DOPS, ALMAT and A-QIPAT. There's no fixed minimum, but they should cover the capabilities for your stage.
Needs at least 3 trainer responses to be valid.
1 Multisource feedback (MSF) with at least 12 responses
Plus a separate ICM MSF if you did an intensive care placement this year.
HALOs completed this year showing on the LLP
A-QIPAT is a good way to record it; national projects such as NAP or SNAP count. Pitch it at the level expected for your stage.
Teaching, courses, management and research, recorded as personal activities.
No set number. Focus on what you learnt and what you changed; verbal reflection with a supervisor counts if they record it.
Exam results entered with the pass letter uploaded
Only if you passed an exam this year.
Triple C forms for any specialty areas you completed
Cardiothoracic, neuro, paediatric or obstetric anaesthesia.
Covers all your work. Declare any serious incident, discuss it with your ES and reflect on it.
Sickness, parental and compassionate leave, and military duties.
"NONE", or say the details are recorded on Form R or SOAR.
Reflect on progress since the last ARCP and your aims for next year.
